name: neuroskill-browser
description: EEG-correlated browser activity tracking for NeuroSkill — tracks browsing patterns, reading behavior, and correlates with your brain state.

scripts.build:all: npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox && npm run build:safari
scripts.package:chrome: npm run build:chrome && cd dist/chrome && zip -r ../../neuroskill-chrome.zip .
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && cd dist/firefox && npx web-ext build --overwrite-dest --artifacts-dir ../../
